jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(C) inventory: Echo Valley Community School District, a unified union district in the Central Vermont Supervisory Union (member towns Orange and Washington).

sources.note: Echo Valley (Orange Washington) articles of agreement, Article 8: the board 'shall be composed of six (6) individuals elected by Australian ballot by the voters of the municipalities in which they reside... three (3) representatives residing in and representing the town of Orange; three (3) representatives residing in and representing the Town of Washington' -- proportional-to-town (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1)); Article 9 sets three-year terms.

Echo Valley Community School District board page (Central Vermont SU, official; updated July 24, 2026): six directors -- Washington: Dominique LaFond Copeland (Chair, term to 2027), Nick Marineau (Clerk, to 2028), Josh Bell (to 2029); Orange: Matthew Flinn (to 2027), Dane Deberville (to 2028), Don Mountford (Vice Chair, to 2029). All six are accounted for in the September 9 and September 30, 2026 minutes.

Nick Marineau was APPOINTED February 5, 2026 to fill the Washington vacancy (Brittany Driscoll's resignation) expressly on an interim basis 'through Town Meeting Day' (Feb. 5, 2026 special-meeting minutes; Feb. 11, 2026 superintendent's report). The district's board page then assigns him the term March 2026-2028 -- exactly the two-year remainder the January 19, 2026 minutes identified as opening at the March 2026 election for that seat. He is recorded ELECTED to the remainder on that chain; the Washington March 3, 2026 ballot results naming him were not fetched (named gap).
